responsibility: This file implements GCC’s main page-based mark-and-sweep garbage collector and its PCH integration. It owns the bag-of-pages allocator, page tables and per-page allocation bitmaps, mark/sweep collection over GGC objects and context depths, finalizer handling, page recycling and release policies, pointer-to-page lookup structures, and the serialization/deserialization of GC-managed objects for precompiled headers.
